note: Export side is factually confirmed: 5 India customs export records dated 2024-01-03 and 2024-03-20, air cargo from Bombay/Sahar to Guatemala, Moldova (Chisinau) and Germany, with B/L numbers. Declared HS '130219;294200' is partly corroborated: 13021990 (belladonna leaf dry extract) matches the declared 130219; however the majority of records carry 29329990 (methoxsalen) and 29397900 (colchicine), which are not in the declared set — per project rule 3 this is NOT a rejection ground, actual codes should be recorded as 13021990 / 29329990 / 29397900. Note the declared 294200 does not appear in any observed record. Slug variants 'inga-pharmaceuticals-pvt-ltd' and 'inga-pharmaceuticals-private-limited' returned zero shipment rows (empty counters), so the legal-entity suffix form is unverified in trade data. Domestic supply: no GST turnover, GeM/CPPP tender or contract evidence could be retrieved — status is declared_only, based solely on the company's own website wording; no domestic supply record was seen. Revenue and export volume figures are not public in the free views and are left null (not invented). Role: manufacturer (site describes own manufacturing units in Mumbai and Chennai, established 1958/2008) — not a pure trader.
